content.text:
**Note:** There is no `prototype/` folder. The live UI is under `frontend-demo/` (Vue3 + Ant Design Vue + VXE Table).

---

## 1. 「隐藏辅助列」button

| Location | Lines | Notes |
|----------|-------|-------|
| `frontend-demo/src/pages/Reserve/ReserveCollectionPage.vue` | **427** | Live reserves worksheet. Toggles `showDetails`; hides 层位/沉积相/岩性/采收率/难动用分类 when off. |
| `frontend-demo/src/pages/Planning/PlanningSchemePage.vue` | **342** | Same pattern for area/state/owner. **Not routed** (legacy orphan; see §4). |

State: `showDetails = ref(true)` at ReserveCollectionPage ~123; columns gated with `v-if="showDetails && …"` (~483–538).

**Not present** on the live production worksheet `PlanningWorkbookPage.vue`.

---

## 2. Sheet switching / workbook tabs (reserves)

**Current (merged single Tab bar)** — `ExcelTable.vue`:

```175:188:frontend-demo/src/components/workbook/ExcelTable.vue
    <!-- Sheet 切换：合并后的单一 Tab 入口（样式复用全局 .metric-group-tabs） -->
    <div class="metric-group-tabs et-sheet-tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="工作表切换">
      <button
        v-for="sheet in sheets"
        ...
        @click="selectSheet(sheet.key)"
      >
        {{ sheet.name }}
      </button>
```

Comments at lines **7–9** state the redesign: one Tab strip (`.metric-group-tabs`), no longer “control-bar dropdown + sidebar buttons”.

**Wired from reserves worksheet:**

| File | Lines |
|------|-------|
| `ReserveCollectionPage.vue` | `sheetTabs` ~346; `<ExcelTable :sheets="sheetTabs" …>` ~398–412 |

**Likely previous UI (CSS leftovers, no Vue usage found):**

| Class | File | Lines |
|-------|------|-------|
| `.sheet-button` / `.sheet-button.active` | `global.css` | **593–615** — full-width sidebar-style sheet buttons |
| `.sheet-bar` / `.sheet-statusbar` | `global.css` | **773–788**, **829–833** |
| `.workbook-sidebar` layout | `global.css` | **556–643** — old 3-column workbook with left sheet list |

No current `.vue` file still uses `class="sheet-button"`. Reserves **统计分析** (`ReserveAnalysisPage.vue`) uses insight tabs (analysis/classification/graphics), not Excel sheet workbook tabs.

Production planning uses the same `ExcelTable` tabs (`PlanningWorkbookPage.vue` ~366–379; sheet defs from `mock/planningSheets.ts` `getWorkbookTabs` ~111–117).

---

## 3. Header edit / “pencil” on table headers

**There is no pencil (`EditOutlined`) on column headers today.**

What exists instead:

| Mechanism | File | Lines | Behavior |
|-----------|------|-------|----------|
| `InlineHeaderEditor` | `components/workbook/InlineHeaderEditor.vue` | **28–46** | Click label → inline rename; hover dashed underline; **no icon** |
| Used on reserves columns | `ReserveCollectionPage.vue` | **473–538** | `#header` slot per column |
| Used on legacy scheme page | `PlanningSchemePage.vue` | **354–402** | Same pattern |
| Column visibility drawer | `HeaderProfileEditor.vue` | **44–61** | Opened via 「列显示设置」(`SettingOutlined`) on reserves ~364 |
| VXE cell edit icon CSS | `ReserveCollectionPage.vue` / `PlanningSchemePage.vue` | ~620–628 / ~487–494 | Styles `.vxe-edit-icon` on **editable cells**, not headers |

Live **`PlanningWorkbookPage`** uses plain `title="油气田"` etc. — **no** `InlineHeaderEditor`.

---

## 4. Why production planning table looks cleaner

Live page: **`PlanningWorkbookPage.vue`** (`/planning/workbook`).

Compared with reserves / legacy scheme:

1. **No「隐藏辅助列」** — identity columns always shown (oilfield/alias/area/state/commissioningYear).
2. **No per-header rename UI** — static titles, less chrome.
3. **Year-matrix layout** — few fixed left cols + `v-for="year in store.years"` (~421–473); one sheet = one metric kind.
4. **Sheet tabs = real attachment sheets** — oil: 3/11–17; gas: 2/7–13 (`planningSheets.ts` 111–117).
5. **Simpler toolbar** — area filter + search + insert row; no template/class/oilfield/status filter stack like reserves.
6. **No data-access card strip** above the grid (reserves has `#data-access` lake/import cards).

Legacy `PlanningSchemePage.vue` still has 隐藏辅助列 + InlineHeaderEditor + nested metric groups — closer to reserves clutter; **not in router** (redirects: `planning/workflow` → `/planning/workbook`).

---

## 5. 「Demo 权限模拟」button

| Piece | Path | Lines |
|-------|------|-------|
| Component | `frontend-demo/src/components/common/DemoRoleSwitcher.vue` | Button label **50–53**; popover title **33** |
| Mounted | `WorkbenchLayout.vue` | Import **17**; render in header actions **126** |

Global top-right of every workbench page (next to 智能助手).

---

## 6. Double scrollbar / overflow — 任务编排

**Page:** `PlanningTaskPage.vue` → `/planning/task`  
**Nav:** `WorkbenchLayout.vue` ~54; router ~48–51.

| Issue | Evidence |
|-------|----------|
| Page-level horizontal overflow (fixed) | `前端全局审查报告_2026-07-22.md` §缺陷 C: scrollWidth 1762 > 1440; fix = `business-page` `minmax(0,1fr)`, `business-content` `min-width:0`, wrap table in `.table-scroll-wrapper` |
| Table wrapper | `PlanningTaskPage.vue` **161–191**, styles **345–351** and **duplicate 370–376** |
| Nested horizontal scroll risk | Wrapper `overflow-x: auto` **plus** VXE internal body scroll → possible **double horizontal** scrollbar if both engage |
| Vertical | No fixed-height page scroll nesting found; page grows with content under Ant Layout |

Related workbook overflow: `.workbook-main { overflow: hidden }` (`global.css` **617–618**) previously blocked tab horizontal scroll (ISS-07); mitigated by `.et-sheet-tabs { flex-wrap: wrap }` in `ExcelTable.vue` ~279–281.

---
